metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the rain, the bridge, the door, and the four gifts in the right hands.

yesterday: The stones stayed off to the left. At Shipston the speech was your own again. The sword and the ribbons stayed dry.
Richard took the bay and began with the price of hay, which was that it is dear.
Anne said you had come, and that you had said so in a letter. Your mother said you are thin. Susanna said thank you, and opened the book.
